title: The Generations from Adam to Noah

verses.1: This is the record of the family line of Adam. When God created people, He made them in His likeness.
verses.2: He created them male and female. He blessed them and called them People on the day He made them.
verses.3: When Adam had lived 130 years, he had a son in his likeness, according to his image, and named him Seth.
verses.4: After he fathered Seth, Adam lived 800 more years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.5: Thus all the days of Adam were 930 years, and he died.
verses.6: When Seth had lived 105 years, he fathered Enosh.
verses.7: After he fathered Enosh, Seth lived 807 more years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.8: Thus all the days of Seth were 912 years, and he died.
verses.9: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he fathered Kenan.
verses.10: After he fathered Kenan, Enosh lived 815 more years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.11: Thus all the days of Enosh were 905 years, and he died.
verses.12: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he fathered Mahalalel.
verses.13: After he fathered Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 more years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.14: Thus all the days of Kenan were 910 years, and he died.
verses.15: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he fathered Jared.
verses.16: After he fathered Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 more years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.17: Thus all the days of Mahalalel were 895 years, and he died.
verses.18: When Jared had lived 162 years, he fathered Enoch.
verses.19: After he fathered Enoch, Jared lived 800 more years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.20: Thus all the days of Jared were 962 years, and he died.
verses.21: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he fathered Methuselah.
verses.22: After he fathered Methuselah, Enoch walked with God for 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.23: Thus all the days of Enoch were 365 years.
verses.24: Enoch walked with God, and he was no longer there because God took him.
verses.25: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he fathered Lamech.
verses.26: After he fathered Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 more years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.27: Thus all the days of Methuselah were 969 years, and he died.
verses.28: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he fathered a son
verses.29: and named him Noah. He said, "This one will bring us rest from the hard work and painful toil of our hands because of the ground the LORD has cursed."
verses.30: After he fathered Noah, Lamech lived 595 more years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.31: Thus all the days of Lamech were 777 years, and he died.
verses.32: After Noah had lived 500 years, he fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
